name: pii-tokens
description: Connects Claude to an MCP server and masks CPF, CNPJ, email, phone and name columns in its results before Claude reads them.

url.title: MCP server URL
url.description: The server Claude reaches through this extension, such as https://metabase.example.com/api/metabase-mcp

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: oauth opens the server's sign-in page in your browser on first use; leave empty for none.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Tool rules for a known server. metabase: adds execute_sql and hides the tools whose data cannot be masked. Empty: only tools marked read-only.

headers.title: Extra headers (JSON)
headers.description: Sent on every request, sign-in included. For an auth proxy in front of the server, such as {"CF-Access-Client-Id": "...", "CF-Access-Client-Secret": "..."}

allow_tools.title: Also allow these tools
allow_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to expose although the rules hide them, such as dashboard_write.

block_tools.title: Block these tools
block_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names never to expose. Wins over everything else.

unmask.title: Unmask in queries
unmask.description: Comma-separated kinds (CPF, CNPJ, EMAIL, PHONE) whose tokens become the real value in what Claude sends, so Claude can filter by them without reading them. A crafted query can bring part of the value back. Empty by default.
